thesis: Every sector starts with a data product built on SPYONAX DATA. That data makes TRADING smarter, TRADING's profits pay for the physical builds, and satellites close the loop by watching the ground.
three: If you build only three, build TRADING for cash, TECHNOLOGY for the data spine, and SPACE through EARTH OBSERVATION. Together they cover Markets and Space, and they reach Earth through satellite data before you own any land, plant or mine.

arcs.name: Markets
arcs.note: Data becomes signals, capital and fees
arcs.flow: Profits and fees pay for the long builds

arcs.name: Space
arcs.flow: EARTH OBSERVATION watches crops, mines, sites and grids

criteria: Uses skills and code you already have
How much it feeds other sectors

sectors.name: SPYONAX TRADING
sectors.headline: Bots run as one gated prop desk
sectors.concept: Run every bot as one prop desk. QRL researches strategies, a fixed gate decides which go live, and capital goes only to strategies that keep passing it.
sectors.customers: No outside customers. The desk trades group capital only, as the Blueprint requires.
sectors.edge: Your bots already run on Dhan, Delta Exchange and Binance. QRL's research streams (microstructure, options, volatility, regimes) give all of them one validation process.
first90: One risk engine across every bot: exposure, margin, and a group-wide daily loss limit with a kill switch.
A strategy register with a four-step gate: backtest, paper, small live, scaled.
Monthly profit attribution by desk and strategy. Retire any strategy that fails its gate.
Separate books for Indian F&O and crypto, because they are taxed differently.
sectors.gate: 12 months of audited live results inside the drawdown limit. That is the Blueprint's trigger for Phase 2 and FINANCE.
sectors.kpi: Return per unit of maximum drawdown, by strategy. Share of capital in strategies that passed the gate.
sectors.risk: Backtests that fail live. Treat every new strategy as unproven until it passes paper and small live.
sectors.check: RBI's principal-business (50-50) test, as the Blueprint notes. Crypto gains are taxed at a flat 30% with 1% TDS.

sectors.name: SPYONAX TECHNOLOGY
sectors.headline: One data spine, with an API to sell
sectors.concept: Build one data spine for the group. SPYONAX DATA collects once, every sector and QRL reads from it, and SPYONAX API sells the parts outsiders will pay for.
sectors.customers: TRADING first. Then quant developers, researchers and fintechs who want clean derivatives history through an API, with no recommendations attached.
sectors.edge: Your data bots already collect crypto options and futures data. A long, clean history is hard for anyone else to copy.
first90: One schema and one store for every bot's data, with automated quality checks.
An internal API that TRADING and QRL use for all research.
Pick one dataset with outside demand, such as crypto options history with implied volatility, and package it with documentation.
Read each exchange's terms before reselling its data.
sectors.gate: A first paying API customer within 9 months of launch. Otherwise keep DATA internal.
sectors.kpi: Number of sectors reading from SPYONAX DATA. External annual recurring revenue.
sectors.risk: Building a platform no outsider pays for. Keep the external product narrow.
sectors.check: Exchange data licences and API terms (NSE data needs a licence to redistribute). DPDP Act, 2023 for any personal data.

sectors.name: SPYONAX SPACE
sectors.headline: Satellite answers before satellites
sectors.concept: Sell satellite answers before building satellites. SPYONAX EARTH OBSERVATION turns bought-in imagery into crop, mine, site and grid intelligence. SPYONAX SATELLITES follows only when customers need data nobody sells.
sectors.customers: AGRI, MINING, LAND, ENERGY and QRL inside the group. Crop insurers, commodity traders, lenders and state agencies outside it.
sectors.money: Analytics subscriptions, per-area reports, and access through SPYONAX API.
sectors.edge: Ground truth from AGRITECH calibrates models for India's small fields, and QRL tests which signals actually move markets.
first90: One district and one crop, using free Sentinel-2 optical imagery plus Sentinel-1 radar, which sees through monsoon cloud.
Acreage and crop-health maps, checked against official estimates.
Show the maps to one insurer and one lender.
sectors.gate: Satellites (Phase 7) only with paying demand that commercial imagery can't meet, IN-SPACe authorisation, and the capital to build.
sectors.kpi: Accuracy against official crop estimates. Number of paying EO customers.
sectors.risk: General satellite analytics is crowded. Win on India-specific ground truth and narrow questions.
sectors.check: IN-SPACe authorisation under the Indian Space Policy, 2023 for satellites. India's geospatial guidelines and each imagery provider's licence terms.

sectors.name: SPYONAX ENERGY
sectors.headline: Forecast power, then generate it
sectors.concept: Forecast power before generating it. SPYONAX GRID sells solar and wind generation forecasts built with QRL's forecasting methods and satellite cloud data. SPYONAX SOLAR builds plants on LAND sites once buyers have signed.
sectors.customers: Wind and solar generators, who must submit generation schedules and pay for deviations from them. Later, industrial buyers of green power.
sectors.money: Forecasting fees per megawatt. Later, long-term power purchase agreements.
sectors.edge: Forecasting generation is a time-series problem like the ones QRL already solves. EARTH OBSERVATION adds cloud imagery for short-range solar forecasts.
first90: Backtest a day-ahead forecast for two or three solar and wind sites with public output data.
Compare its error with the deviation bands generators are charged on.
Pitch one generator or scheduling agency.
sectors.gate: Plants (Phase 4) only when LAND has a site and a buyer has signed a power purchase agreement.
sectors.kpi: Forecast error against actual output. Megawatts under forecasting contracts.
sectors.risk: Established forecasting firms. Later, slow payments and open-access rules that differ by state.
sectors.check: Forecasting, scheduling and deviation rules of the central and state electricity commissions. Open-access rules for selling power to industry.

sectors.name: SPYONAX AGRI
sectors.headline: Crop intelligence that collects ground truth
sectors.firstMoney: Per-hectare fees from FPOs and insurers
sectors.concept: Software before farmland. SPYONAX AGRITECH gives farmer producer organisations, insurers and lenders field-level crop intelligence, and collects the ground truth that makes EARTH OBSERVATION accurate.
sectors.customers: Farmer producer organisations (FPOs), crop insurers, agri lenders and input companies. Farmers get advice free on WhatsApp, in their own language.
sectors.money: Per-hectare, per-season fees paid by the institution.
sectors.edge: EARTH OBSERVATION, DATA and AI LAB are already in place. Each season's harvest data makes the models better, and no one can buy that history.
first90: One FPO, 500 to 1,000 farmers, one crop, one district.
Collect geotagged field photos, sowing dates and harvest yields.
Ask for a paid pilot from the start.
sectors.gate: Paying customers for two seasons. Then use the post-harvest loss data to choose where COLD CHAIN pays.
sectors.kpi: Paid hectares. Yield-forecast error against the actual harvest.
sectors.risk: Farmers rarely pay for advice, so charge institutions instead.
sectors.check: DPDP Act, 2023 consent for farmer data. FSSAI and APEDA later, for foods and exports.

sectors.name: SPYONAX FINANCE
sectors.start: Phase 2, when the gate is met
sectors.headline: A regulated quant fund
sectors.concept: Offer QRL's proven strategies to outside investors through a regulated quant fund, and only after the group's own money has proven them.
sectors.customers: High-net-worth investors, family offices and institutions who meet SEBI's minimum investment.
sectors.edge: An audited live record from TRADING, run on the same risk engine the fund will use.
first90: Brief counsel on the vehicle. A Category III AIF is the usual choice for derivatives-heavy quant strategies, and PMS is the alternative.
Get TRADING's records audited.
Write rules for conflicts between the prop desk and the fund, such as which book gets a trade first.
sectors.gate: The Blueprint's Phase 2 gate: an audited record, an agreed licence route, and capital for the net-worth requirement. Most outside investors want two to three years of record.
sectors.kpi: Assets under management. Fee income against compliance cost.
sectors.risk: Compliance costs arrive before assets do.
sectors.check: SEBI registration for the fund or PMS, in its own licensed entity. Hold words like Asset Management until the licence path is clear (rule N8).

sectors.name: SPYONAX INDUSTRIES
sectors.headline: Electronics the group needs first
sectors.concept: Design the electronics the group needs first: field sensors, battery management and power electronics. Sell them to outside buyers once they work inside the group.
sectors.customers: AGRI, ENERGY, LAND and SPACE inside the group. Outside equipment makers later.
sectors.edge: Guaranteed internal demand gives the first volume. Government electronics incentive schemes support manufacturing in India.
first90: One product: a low-cost sensor node for fields and warehouses.
Design it in-house and build it with a contract manufacturer.
Pilot it with AGRITECH and WAREHOUSING.
sectors.gate: An own factory only with steady outside orders and an INDUSTRIAL PARKS site ready.
sectors.kpi: Units shipped. Gross margin per unit.
sectors.risk: Hardware ties up cash, and cheap imports set the price.
sectors.check: BIS certification for regulated electronics. A factory licence and pollution-control consent for an own plant.

sectors.name: SPYONAX LAND
sectors.headline: A land bank that earns rent
sectors.concept: Build a land bank that earns while it waits. SPYONAX WAREHOUSING and INDUSTRIAL PARKS collect rent now and hold the sites that SOLAR and INDUSTRIES will need later.
sectors.customers: Logistics, e-commerce and manufacturing tenants, plus the group's own ENERGY, INDUSTRIES and AGRI cold chain.
sectors.money: Lease rent, plus land value over time.
sectors.edge: Site selection from EARTH OBSERVATION and DATA, covering roads, substations and flood risk. The group can be its own anchor tenant.
first90: A site-selection model on satellite and public data, before buying anything.
One build-to-suit warehouse with a tenant signed before construction starts.
sectors.gate: The Blueprint's gate of surplus capital, plus a signed tenant for every building.
sectors.risk: Capital-heavy and slow, with a risk of land-title disputes.
sectors.check: Title checks, land-use conversion approvals, state limits on buying agricultural land, and RERA for anything sold to buyers.

sectors.name: SPYONAX MINING
sectors.headline: Discover deposits, sell the rights
sectors.concept: Find deposits and sell the rights. SPYONAX EXPLORATION maps critical-mineral targets from satellite and geological data and wins exploration licences. Partners run the mines.
sectors.customers: Companies bidding in critical-mineral block auctions. Later, the buyers of licensed discoveries.
sectors.money: Prospect reports first. Later, a share of the value when a deposit found under an exploration licence goes to auction.
sectors.edge: EARTH OBSERVATION, AI LAB and MATERIALS LAB, plus open geoscience data from the Geological Survey of India.
first90: A prospect model for one critical mineral in one geological belt, built from public data.
Sell the report to one auction bidder.
sectors.gate: Mine operation (Phase 6) only with exploration capital, identified blocks, and an operating partner.
sectors.kpi: Targets confirmed by drilling. Paying bidders.
sectors.risk: Exploration succeeds rarely and takes years.
sectors.check: The 2023 amendment to the MMDR Act created exploration licences for critical and deep-seated minerals, so confirm the current terms. Forest and environmental clearances.

sectors.name: SPYONAX MEDICAL
sectors.headline: Enter through VENTURES
sectors.concept: Enter through VENTURES before building anything. Take a stake in, or partner with, an Indian AI-diagnostics company, and build SPYONAX DIAGNOSTICS in-house only after hiring a medical leader.
sectors.customers: Diagnostic labs, hospitals and government screening programmes.
sectors.edge: AI LAB and BIO LAB. This is the sector least connected to the Earth, Markets and Space loop, which is why a light entry fits.
first90: Map the CDSCO route for diagnostic software, which is regulated as a medical device.
Shortlist three to five AI-diagnostics startups for a VENTURES stake.
Pick one narrow screening use case.
sectors.gate: The Blueprint's gate: medical and regulatory leaders hired, and the CDSCO route mapped.
sectors.risk: Long approvals, clinical liability, and strong incumbents.
sectors.check: CDSCO rules for software as a medical device. Clinical-trial and ethics-committee approvals.

changes: The Blueprint lets it begin early. Make it a commitment, because it needs no land or licence and it serves QRL as well as AGRI.
Give ENERGY a data entry in Phase 2 or 3.
Generation forecasting under SPYONAX GRID uses the same skills as QRL and needs no land.
Bring MEDICAL in through SPYONAX VENTURES first.
It is the sector with the weakest link to the rest of the group and the heaviest regulation.
Win exploration licences and let partners run the mines.
Write a capital policy for SPYONAX CAPITAL.
Sweep a fixed share of TRADING's realised profit to Holdings each quarter, keep 12 months of group runway in cash, and release capital to a sector only when its gate is met.
next30: Build the risk engine, the kill switch and the strategy register.
Put all bot data in one schema, pick the first outside dataset, and read each exchange's data terms.
Commission the SPYONAX clearance search (Blueprint protection step 1) before anything goes public.
Ask your CA about RBI's 50-50 test and whether TRADING needs its own company from day one (Blueprint decision 3).
Prototype a Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 crop map for one district over a weekend.
notes: Uses only names already in the SPYONAX Group Blueprint. None has been cleared yet (rule N9).
Scores are my judgement from what I could see of the group's current work.
Regulatory lines are pointers for your CA, company secretary and lawyer, not legal advice. Rules change, so confirm current requirements before acting.
